title: NTE (No TNT Explosions)
description: Makes sure TNT cant explode and remains a cosmetic block
body:
# Have you ever just wanted tnt to be cosmetic?
Well with No TNT Explosions you can make sure that no tnt is going to explode!
You might be asking why is this pack on an old version of minecraft?
The answer is that in 1.21.5 there was a gamerule introduced that makes tnt not explode.
Basically taking this packs job. 
So instead its made for versions older that you still want to have a similar rule with!
